dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Hey there, big shots! Any orders for me? Novelist and up-and-coming mercenary Souka is at your command!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know, it sometimes surprises Paimon how Souka's been getting more and more energetic and motivated ever since she started looking after the Fungi friends with Haniyyah.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's the novel business going?

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Haha! The prose for my novella, Labyrinth of Legend: A Hero's Journey, was actually pretty well-received...

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: But when Aratani asked me if I planned to keep it going as a series, I thought about it and decided that I wanted to focus my energy on the works related to my Fungi friends, so I turned him down...

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: So, barring any unforeseen circumstances, "using pictures and a broadcasting device to turn my novel into an audio-visual, three-dimensional reading experience"...

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Due to insufficient funding, this project was scaled back heavily. In the end, all that was left were the text and illustrations, making it no different from any other ordinary novel.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aw, that's a shame...

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: It's no big deal! That's just how it goes with new-generation projects these days.

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: The plan was made to be so ideal, but when the time to find artists and composers came, I ran into walls everywhere... Then there's also that claymore they call a "budget" hanging over my head!

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Having that claymore drop on me early was actually for the best. It kept me from getting carried away with unrealistic fantasies.

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: The creative process is essentially just a series of collisions... Sometimes, we collide into walls! Thud after thud after thud... but one must learn to embrace the small joys along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Paimon isn't sure if she should comfort you or call you an optimist.

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Anyway, with the bad news out of the way, I have some truly good news to share~

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: I've finished my latest work, "The Fungi Clan"! It's already with the editors for reviewing and proofreading.

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: In a little over half a year, it should be ready for printing. I'll give you each a copy then!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You went with this title in the end?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I figured you'd go for something more complex.

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: I won't lie, I really wanted to go with that naming style that's all the rage nowadays. The one where you take a long sentence and insist on making it the title.

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: However, many light novels that attract audiences with quirky titles also feature rather peculiar settings, with plot twists and positive feedback so abundant the story is saturated with them.

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Authors who can keep a story racing forward and consistently give their audience a sense of satisfaction are certainly impressive. But not every work has to be like that...

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: If all authors just aim for the so-called "optimal solution" in their creations, wouldn't it become a kind of... cliche? Sooner or later, the audience is bound to grow weary of it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That... makes sense. Reading one or two stories with the same formula's more than enough.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If everyone writes this way, it might end up doing more harm than good.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You need a mix of fast and slow to keep things balanced.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A wealth of different styles keeps things interesting.

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: In any case, while writing, I've realized that the bond Haniyyah and I share with our Fungi friends, and the adventures we had together, feel much more traditional and slow-paced...

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: So, returning to a simple, modest title actually fits the vibe of our story much better. I just hope that when the time comes, the readers it attracts will take their time to savor the narrative!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Up-and-coming mercenary? How did that happen?

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Hooah! I've been with Haniyyah for so long that I've picked up all her combat moves!

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Not only that, but I've actually started taking on mercenary orders in between my writing to help make ends meet.

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Sure, a legendary beast would probably send me flying in a single hit. But chasing off a few hilichurls, scorpions or vultures? I can handle that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon never thought things would take this turn when she first saw you in Haniyyah's clothes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is this, uh, normal for a light novel author? Are you sure you'll be fine?

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Of course I'm doing this right!

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Tagging along with Haniyyah to share her food, drinks, and even her Fungi friends, embarking on adventures in foreign lands that I once thought of as distant frontiers...

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Even when I'm just sitting still in camp, there's a steady stream of new things to see and hear. The inspiration to write just flows toward me like a mountain spring...

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Could I get any luckier as a light novel author? It feels wrong to just sit back and enjoy all of this without paying her my fair share!

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: I've been setting aside a portion of my royalties and wages over the last few years, and I'm going to give it all to her when the time comes!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The order is to take good care of yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. You always seem to be in such high spirits, so... just don't forget to eat well and get enough sleep.

dialogues.speaker: Souka
dialogues.text: Understood! That goes for both of you big shots too!
